  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to make building with ElevenLabs easier, from a developer's first API key to a successful production integration.

Developer Growth owns the surfaces developers and their agents use: our SDKs, API, documentation and ElevenAPI dashboard. This role focuses on the dashboard and product flows, helping self-serve and enterprise developers get started, understand their usage and get more value from ElevenLabs.

You will join a small, remote team and own features across frontend and backend. You will use direct user feedback and experiments to decide what to build, combining strong engineering with a careful eye for developer experience.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Improving the ElevenAPI dashboard so developers can manage integrations and understand how their applications and agents use ElevenLabs.

  • Streamlining onboarding, helping developers create API keys, get started with agents and reach their first successful integration.

  • Designing and shipping experiments to improve activation, API key creation and self-serve subscriptions, then using the results to guide further changes.

  • Owning features from discovery and design through frontend, backend, deployment and iteration, working closely with the team and learning from users.

There is scope to grow into technical and team leadership over time, depending on your experience and impact.

Requirements

  • Strong full-stack engineering skills, with particular strength in frontend development and confidence building backend services and APIs.

  • Strong product judgement and attention to UX, with evidence of making complex workflows intuitive for developers.

  • Experience using user feedback, product data and experimentation to prioritise work and improve measurable outcomes.

  • Independent, end-to-end ownership, clear communication and genuine enthusiasm for developer tools and developer experience.

  • Experience managing or mentoring a small team of software engineers

Prior generative audio experience is not required. Experience building developer-facing products, API dashboards or onboarding flows is particularly valuable. Previous technical or team leadership experience is a plus.

Location:

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Senior Software Engineer — AI-Native Engineering (XTM Foundation)
description: 🌀 The Company Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action. Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action. At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative. As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future. 🎯 The Role We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is genuinely, deeply convinced that AI is transforming the way software gets built, and who wants to make that transformation happen at Filigran. We are looking for an engineer first. This isn't a "we bought Copilot, please roll it out" role, and it isn't only a tooling or development role either: part of the job is building, part of it is trying things on real work, measuring them and telling teams honestly what works and what doesn't. This is a practitioner role for someone who has already lived this shift, who experiments constantly, who knows what works and what doesn't, and who can bring 60 engineers along on that journey. You will join the XTM Foundation team as Filigran's internal reference on AI-Native engineering. You'll propose our approach, build our practices, run experiments, and share the results so that teams can change how they work with confidence. You'll be hands-on, opinionated, and always one step ahead. 💼 Your Responsibilities Define and own Filigran's AI-Native engineering strategy: which tools, which workflows, which practices, and how they evolve as the landscape moves fast. Run structured experiments to evaluate new AI coding tools and agents (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Cline, MCP servers, code generation agents…), measure their real impact on velocity and quality, and translate findings into actionable recommendations. Build the guardrails and engineering standards that ensure AI-generated code is maintainable, tested, and consistent with our quality bar — not just fast to produce. Work directly with product engineering teams (~80 engineers) to embed AI practices into their day-to-day workflows: pair programming with AI, AI-assisted code review, test generation, documentation, and beyond. Share what you learn. Run internal talks, workshops, and demos. Be the person engineers come to when they want to understand what's possible, and what isn't. Show real results, including the failures. Stay permanently ahead of the curve — the AI tooling landscape moves weekly. You'll be the one tracking it, filtering the noise, and surfacing what actually matters for a team like ours. Work in the XTM Foundation team to turn AI practices into shared building blocks for every product team: agent workflows in our CI pipelines (dependency updates, flaky test triage, review assistance), shared MCP servers and prompt libraries, versioned AI configuration in the repositories, and written rules on tools and data handling that apply to everyone. Contribute to Filigran's external voice on AI-Native engineering — blog posts, open-source contributions, conference talks — as the opportunity arises. 🤝 Who You'll Work With Reports to: Principal Engineer of XTM Foundation team. Key collaborators: Engineers and Engineering Managers across OpenCTI, OpenAEV, and OpenGRC product teams; VP of Technology; CTO. Working model: You will split your time between XTM Foundation team work (research, experimentation, standards) and direct collaboration with product teams to embed AI practices in real engineering workflows. 🧬 Profile We're Looking For 7+ years of software engineering experience — you are a strong engineer first. You understand what good code looks like, and that's what makes your judgment on AI credible. You are genuinely AI-first in how you work. Not as a trend, not as a productivity hack. You've already transformed how you build software, you can show what you built and what you measured, and you want to help others do the same. Proven experience deploying AI-assisted development practices within an engineering team: you've done this before, you know what resistance looks like, and you know what actually works and what doesn't. Deep, hands-on familiarity with the current AI coding tooling landscape: agentic coding tools, LLM-powered code review, prompt engineering for development workflows, MCP ecosystems, and what's coming next. Strong full-stack engineering background — you can evaluate AI output across the whole stack and contribute code yourself when it matters. You can make a clear case, with evidence. You're a natural communicator who can discuss a trade-off with a skeptical senior engineer just as well as you can help a junior developer get started. Comfortable working in a remote-first, async culture with teams across multiple time zones; clear communicator in English. Autonomy and ownership mindset: you drive this agenda without waiting for direction, and you bring others with you rather than working alone. Bonus: experience with open-source communities, cybersecurity domain knowledge, contributions to AI tooling projects, or public writing/speaking on AI-Native engineering. 🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job. We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company , and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation . You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem. ⭐ Be part of something bigger We believe we do work that matters. Our open-source approach means that work extends beyond Filigran. You’re contributing to technology and ideas that strengthen a global community of defenders and help make cybersecurity more open and collaborative. 💻 Work at the edge of what’s next We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportunity to work with emerging technologies, experiment with new ways of working, and contribute to how they are applied in practice. 🌍 Global opportunity without borders Be part of a fast-growing, truly international team — collaborating across Europe, North America, APJ and beyond, with the flexibility of a remote-first environment. As we grow, you’ll have opportunities to expand your scope, take ownership, learn quickly and grow with us. 🧭 A culture grounded in CORE Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity define how we work together — with openness, ownership, collaboration and respect. These are the principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people and grow together, especially when no one’s watching. 💰 What you can expect Competitive compensation + equity — everyone shares in our success Remote-first flexibility — work from wherever you’re based, with flexibility built into how we operate 25 days PTO baseline — real time to disconnect, recharge and enjoy life outside work Volunteer days — paid time to contribute to causes that matter to you Set up for success — choose the equipment that works for you, with additional support for your remote work and development needs as our programs evolve Two annual in-person get-togethers — one global company get-together and one team get-together, creating dedicated time to connect, collaborate and strengthen our culture beyond the screen 🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity We enable cybersecurity through inclusion — from code to culture. At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe the diversity of our people makes our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or veteran status. What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from or how you identify. 🚀 Ready to Join Us? Apply now and help us build the future of the cybersecurity ecosystem, together.

  • Deep, hands-on familiarity with the current AI coding tooling landscape: agentic coding tools, LLM-powered code review, prompt engineering for development workflows, MCP ecosystems, and what's coming next.

  • Strong full-stack engineering background — you can evaluate AI output across the whole stack and contribute code yourself when it matters.

  • You can make a clear case, with evidence. You're a natural communicator who can discuss a trade-off with a skeptical senior engineer just as well as you can help a junior developer get started.

  • Comfortable working in a remote-first, async culture with teams across multiple time zones; clear communicator in English.

  • Autonomy and ownership mindset: you drive this agenda without waiting for direction, and you bring others with you rather than working alone.

  • Bonus: experience with open-source communities, cybersecurity domain knowledge, contributions to AI tooling projects, or public writing/speaking on AI-Native engineering.

We enable cybersecurity through inclusion — from code to culture.

At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe the diversity of our people makes our products and our team stronger. Staff Web Engineer Marketing

About the role

Deepgram builds foundational voice AI and deepgram.com is where the world meets it. The site is our digital front door, showcasing our products, brand moments, and pricing information, and it drives the company's self-serve revenue.

We're hiring a Staff Web Engineer to own the site's code for the long haul. Deepgram.com is entering its next chapter. We are fully refreshing the experience top to bottom. You'll be the person who knows the site inside out. You'll own the repo, the architecture, the Sanity environments, and the QA bar — and act as the code-review gate for day-to-day page and content work. The team is small but scaling. You will be working on the Web team reporting into the Head of Brand & Awareness and closely collaborating with our Senior Web Manager, product, marketing, sales, and external development partners.

Most critically, as an AI company, you must be AI-native. Agents and AI tooling are your go-to in how you choose to build, review, and QA. We are aiming to build a machine-first, voice-first site experience. It’s an exciting time to join the web team.

What you'll do

  • Own the deepgram.com codebase end to end — the Next.js application (front and back end), the GitHub repo, branching and CI/CD, and code review

  • Optimize and maintain Sanity CMS architecture — schemas, the reusable module library, the staging and production environments and publishing workflow

  • Run the global design system, component library, Vercel platform and spearhead AI integrations. Experienced with global CSS systems.

  • Build and run the site's QA program — starting with a well-structured and scalable staging environment that keeps a marketing site launch-ready at all times

  • Lead internationalization and localization efforts — language-locale URL and routing architecture, hreflang, and the path from i18n plumbing to localized (l10n) content

  • Assist in technical SEO — site architecture, redirects, Core Web Vitals — with on-page SEO executed by content partners inside your review gate

  • Ensure LLM discoverability (AEO) — the site's structured data, metadata, and content architecture must serve answer engines as well as people

  • Technical infrastructure for experimentation — develop the mechanisms to support the site's experimentation program

  • Marketing Ops partnership — implementation of forms, gated content, and attribution instrumentation (GTM, GA4, HubSpot)

  • Cybersecurity posture — maintain security and run routine safety audits across dependencies and scripts

  • High-velocity shipping — ship complex site improvements and launch campaign pages in a product-driven atmosphere

  • AI-native workflow — use agents in your daily build process and create tooling for safe marketing publishing

We are looking for candidates with:

  • Marketing web development background — ownership of marketing sites, not just product surfaces

  • Enterprise repository ownership: branching strategy, CI/CD, and a strong code-review culture

  • Headless CMS architecture — Next.js with Sanity strongly preferred

  • Modern React ecosystem for the web

  • Vercel as a production platform

  • AI-native development — ability to demonstrate concrete use of AI agents and tooling in your workflow

  • High level of ownership & accountability — a hand raiser who’s ready to join an ambitious team and company

  • Technical leadership — directing or reviewing the work of agency developers

Our ideal candidates also have:

  • Prior experience with internationalization (i18n/l10n): URL architecture, locale routing, and multi-region infrastructure

  • Familiarity with A/B testing on production marketing sites

  • Interest in voice AI and the future of voice-interactive web experiences

description: Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production. Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first. We are a fully remote global company with employees in Canada, the United States and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien! The Mission Caylent's Anthropic Business Unit is a dedicated AI services practice built in partnership with Anthropic — Anthropic's first pure-play delivery partner. Engagements are production-grade: agents, data products, AI-augmented operations, workforce transformation. Senior FDEs run their own accounts — full relationship, from discovery through close, without anyone above managing the engagement. You scope, architect, build, and close. You are the account. We hire into two specializations: Technology-Workforce FDEs run solo technical engagements in engineering and IT organizations, owning architecture decisions and LLM-native delivery end-to-end; Operational FDEs lead single-function AI adoption programs across business workforces — persona discovery, role-specific enablement, and workflow automations deployed and owned by you. Your Assignment Own the full client relationship on your account from discovery through close Make architecture and build decisions appropriate to the client's environment and constraints; stand behind them Run discovery, architecture reviews, and stakeholder interviews independently; translate ambiguous problems into scoped, deliverable work Identify scope creep and manage it — surface risks before they become problems Identify and surface expansion opportunities Transfer capability that lasts: documented, runnable, maintainable software or automations that work after you leave Contribute IP back to the practice after every engagement: patterns, templates, and reusable components Your Qualifications 5+ years of engineering or technical delivery experience with meaningful time in embedded or client-facing contexts Proven solo account delivery: evidence you've owned a client relationship from kickoff through close without supervision Hands-on depth in one or more of: LLM application development, cloud-native architecture (AWS preferred), backend systems at scale, or enterprise business automation Demonstrated ability to make independent technical decisions and manage your own delivery quality inside client environments Strong communicator: technically precise with engineers, clear and confident with VP-level leadership; adjusts depth without losing accuracy High tolerance for ambiguity; consistently delivers value before all requirements are defined Preferred Qualifications Experience building production AI systems: RAG pipelines, agents, fine-tuned models, or LLM-native applications Hands-on with Claude, AWS Bedrock, or equivalent — model parameters, prompt architecture, tool use Background in a consulting firm, systems integrator, or professional services environment Familiarity with SOW-based delivery and scope management AWS certifications: Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Engineer Professional, or equivalent Operational Preferred Background in management consulting, enterprise SaaS implementation, or a business function you know deeply from the inside Experience designing and running AI enablement programs for non-technical business audiences Hands-on with Zapier, Power Automate, Airtable, or similar; familiarity with enterprise systems like Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow Track record working cross-functionally — comfortable in Finance and Legal and Operations in the same engagement Who Thrives here You carry an account without daily check-ins, read tension in a client org before it surfaces, and bring expansion signals forward without being asked. This role is structured around full account ownership — people who do well here are energized by that autonomy and accountability. Why This Team The work is at the frontier — agents, AI product builds, enterprise adoption — and you own the outcomes, not just the hours. Autonomy with backing: minimal oversight in the field, a strong technical bench behind you when the problem warrants it. Advancement tied to delivery performance and expansion generation, not tenure. Benefits 100% remote work Medical Insurance for you and eligible dependents Generous holidays and flexible PTO Competitive phantom equity Paid for exams and certifications Peer bonus awards State of the art laptop and tools Equipment & Office Stipend Individual professional development plan Annual stipend for Learning and Development Work with an amazing worldwide team and in an incredible corporate culture This role may require up to 50% travel, depending on business needs. NOTE: This position requires current legal authorization to work in the country where this position is located. Caylent is not able to sponsor visa or work permit applications at this time. At Caylent, we are committed to fair, transparent, and inclusive hiring practices. Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production.

Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first.

We are a fully remote global company with employees in Canada, the United States and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien!

The Mission

As a Senior CXE Engineer, you are a hands-on builder on enterprise contact center transformations. You will spend the majority of your time in code and in the AWS console: building contact flows and AI agents, writing Lambda functions and CDK stacks, developing React-based agent and admin tooling, and debugging production issues on systems that serve tens of thousands of agents and millions of customer interactions. You work within architectures set by practice leads, and you’re expected to pressure-test them, propose better patterns, and own the implementation quality of your workstream from first commit through production cutover. This role blends deep Amazon Connect platform engineering, generative AI development on Bedrock and Claude, and full-stack serverless work, with regular direct interaction with customer engineering teams.

Your Assignment

AI Agent & Conversational AI Development

  • Build AI-native self-service using Amazon Connect AI agents, Amazon Q in Connect, and Amazon Bedrock (Claude model family), implementing multi-agent orchestration patterns, orchestrator agents delegating to task-specific agents with escalation paths to human queues
  • Engineer prompts and tool-calling integrations at production scale: SearchProfiles lookups, case creation, external API tools, authentication flows, and guardrails against hallucination and verification loops
  • Implement barge-in handling, fallback, and error-recovery behavior for voice AI, and validate it with turn-by-turn trace analysis
  • Optimize inference cost and latency hands-on: model tier selection (Haiku vs. Sonnet vs. Opus), prompt caching, and token budgeting against containment- rate targets
  • Diagnose AI agent performance using observability tooling (agent spans, and CloudWatch) that correlates contact flow logs, conversation transcripts, AI agent spans, tool executions, and token usage to isolate latency, cost, and quality issues
  • Build conversational experiences where intent-based NLU is the right fit, including multilingual support and SSML-tuned voice interactions

Amazon Connect Platform Engineering

  • Build contact flows that integrate AI agents, Lambda-backed business logic, Customer Profiles, and dynamic data-driven routing
  • Implement Amazon Connect Cases and Tasks solutions: case templates, queue-based work allocation, SLA/TAT monitoring, approval workflows, and migrations from legacy case systems (e.g., consolidating hundreds of service categories and thousands of business rules into a unified Cases model)
  • Configure and operationalize Contact Lens for real-time sentiment, post-contact summaries, category rules, and quality management
  • Implement proficiency-based and attribute-driven routing, outbound campaigns (including answering machine detection and compliance controls), and workforce management (WFM) integrations for forecasting, scheduling, and adherence (FCS)
  • Build out the Amazon Connect analytics data lake (Glue, Lake Formation, Athena) and QuickSight dashboards for real-time operations and executive reporting
  • Support legacy platform migrations (Avaya, Genesys, Cisco, Oracle, Salesforce): flow conversion, data migration, parallel-run validation, and production cutover on live contact centers

Full-Stack & Portal Engineering

  • Build custom Agent Workspace experiences with the Amazon Connect Streams API, third-party app embedding, and CRM screen-pop integrations (Salesforce, ServiceNow, Oracle, custom systems)
  • Build serverless, event-driven backends with Lambda, EventBridge, Step Functions, SQS/SNS, DynamoDB, and Kinesis for real-time event processing and customer journey orchestration
  • Treat accessibility as a first-class requirement: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant components, automated axe-core/Playwright accessibility scanning, and support for VPAT/Section 508 documentation on government and enterprise engagements

Infrastructure, Delivery & Quality

  • Author infrastructure as code with AWS CDK (TypeScript) as the primary tool and CloudFormation or Terraform where customer environments require them
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) and automated test suites: Jest/Vitest unit tests, Playwright E2E and API tests, and integration tests against live Connect instances
  • Follow phased rollout patterns for production contact centers where downtime is measured in missed calls; write the runbooks that make cutovers boring
  • Instrument monitoring and alerting (CloudWatch metrics, alarms, and custom dashboards across voice, chat, tasks, queues, agents, Lambda, and AI agents) and participate in production incident triage
  • Apply security and compliance baselines in everything you ship: least-privilege IAM, DevSecOps scanning, encryption standards

Collaboration & Practice Contribution

  • Work directly with customer engineering teams: pair on integrations, run technical working sessions, demo completed workstreams, and lead knowledge transfer so customers can operate what you build
  • Contribute to architecture decisions within your workstream; evaluate native Connect capability before custom builds (“configuration over customization”), surface trade-offs to practice leads, and document decisions
  • Perform code reviews, uphold engineering standards, and mentor junior and mid-level CX engineers through pairing and review feedback
  • Contribute reusable assets back to the practice, shared CDK constructs, skills/plugins, demo environments, and internal tooling, so the next engagement starts further ahead
  • Support pre-sales when needed: build proof-of-concept demos and provide implementation-grounded input on estimates and SOW technical scope

Your Qualifications

  • 7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including 2+ years building on Amazon Connect or comparable CCaaS platforms at enterprise scale
  • Strong, current Amazon Connect skills: contact flows, routing, Cases and Tasks, Contact Lens, Customer Profiles, Streams API, and the Connect data/analytics stack
  • Hands-on experience with conversational and generative AI, Amazon Lex plus LLM- based development (Amazon Bedrock, Q in Connect, or equivalent), including prompt engineering and tool calling
  • Strong TypeScript/Node.js and Python; production React experience; solid AWS serverless engineering (Lambda, EventBridge, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Step Functions, Kinesis)
  • Infrastructure as code proficiency with AWS CDK or Terraform, including multi- account deployment patterns
  • Experience shipping and supporting production systems, testing discipline, observability instrumentation, and incident debugging across the full stack
  • Clear communication with customer-facing composure, able to demo your work, explain trade-offs, and run working sessions with client engineers

Preferred Qualifications

  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect, Developer, or ML/Connect-relevant Specialty)
  • Contact center migration experience (Avaya, Genesys, Cisco, Oracle, or Salesforce to Amazon Connect)
  • Experience in regulated verticals: government/public sector (Section 508, FedRAMP), healthcare (HIPAA), or financial services
  • Contact center operations fluency: WFM concepts (forecasting, scheduling, adherence), quality management, outbound compliance (TCPA), and CX KPIs (containment, AHT, CSAT, SLA/TAT)
  • Experience with AI observability (trace correlation, token/cost attribution, latency profiling) or accessibility engineering (WCAG 2.1 AA, axe-core automation)
  • Consulting or client-delivery background

Benefits

  • 100% remote work
  • Medical Insurance for you and eligible dependents
  • Generous holidays and flexible PTO
  • Competitive phantom equity
  • Paid for exams and certifications
  • Peer bonus awards
  • State of the art laptop and tools
  • Equipment & Office Stipend
  • Individual professional development plan

  • Work with an amazing worldwide team and in an incredible corporate culture

title: Senior Software Engineer
description: What Makes Cloudbeds Unique At Cloudbeds , we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. This is a product engineering role focused on production AI systems, agentic workflows, evaluation, and observability - not an internal tooling role. You'll work primarily in Python while collaborating across our broader PHP and Java ecosystem, building systems where correctness, reliability, latency, cost, and model quality are core to the job. Your goal is to help Cloudbeds ship AI-powered customer experiences that are useful, trusted, scalable, and measurable. Our Core AI Squad: The Core AI Squad owns the customer-facing AI platform infrastructure, agentic workflows, and evaluation and observability foundations that enable AI-powered experiences across Cloudbeds products. The team builds the production capabilities that let us evaluate models and providers for specific use cases, orchestrate tools and workflows, measure quality over time, and integrate AI safely into real customer journeys. You'll join a senior, product-minded group that values ownership, pragmatic architecture, fast learning, and strong collaboration across product, design, data, and engineering. What You Bring to the Team: Design, build, and operate customer-facing AI platform services and product features primarily in Python, while integrating with PHP and Java systems as needed Build and evolve agentic harnesses, including agent runtimes, workflow orchestration, tool execution, state management, recovery paths, and evaluation hooks Integrate agents and LLM-powered workflows into production systems with strong attention to reliability, correctness, latency, scalability, and cost Evaluate models and providers for specific product use cases, using clear success criteria and abstractions that keep the platform flexible as the AI ecosystem evolves Own evaluation, tracing, observability, and quality feedback loops for AI features so the team can detect regressions, raw.jobDescription:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.

How You'll Make an Impact:

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Core AI Squad, you'll design, build, and operate customer-facing AI platform capabilities that power intelligent product experiences across Cloudbeds. This is a product engineering role focused on production AI systems, agentic workflows, evaluation, and observability - not an internal tooling role. You'll work primarily in Python while collaborating across our broader PHP and Java ecosystem, building systems where correctness, reliability, latency, cost, and model quality are core to the job. Your goal is to help Cloudbeds ship AI-powered customer experiences that are useful, trusted, scalable, and measurable.

Our Core AI Squad:

The Core AI Squad owns the customer-facing AI platform infrastructure, agentic workflows, and evaluation and observability foundations that enable AI-powered experiences across Cloudbeds products. The team builds the production capabilities that let us evaluate models and providers for specific use cases, orchestrate tools and workflows, measure quality over time, and integrate AI safely into real customer journeys. You'll join a senior, product-minded group that values ownership, pragmatic architecture, fast learning, and strong collaboration across product, design, data, and engineering.

What You Bring to the Team:

  • Design, build, and operate customer-facing AI platform services and product features primarily in Python, while integrating with PHP and Java systems as needed
  • Build and evolve agentic harnesses, including agent runtimes, workflow orchestration, tool execution, state management, recovery paths, and evaluation hooks
  • Integrate agents and LLM-powered workflows into production systems with strong attention to reliability, correctness, latency, scalability, and cost
  • Evaluate models and providers for specific product use cases, using clear success criteria and abstractions that keep the platform flexible as the AI ecosystem evolves
  • Own evaluation, tracing, observability, and quality feedback loops for AI features so the team can detect regressions, understand behavior, and improve over time
  • Write clean, well-tested, well-documented code and advocate for engineering best practices, test automation, maintainability, and operational excellence
  • Collaborate with product, design, data, security, and engineering partners to turn ambiguous AI product opportunities into reliable customer-facing features
  • Comfort building, debugging, and operating services that interact with PostgreSQL, SQS, gRPC, and REST APIs, including data models, event streams, service contracts, and versioning
  • Contribute as a senior individual contributor through technical leadership, architecture input, pair programming, code reviews, and mentorship

What Sets You Up for Success:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience building, shipping, and operating production systems
  • Strong proficiency with Python in production environments, including APIs, services, tests, debugging, and operational ownership
  • Hands-on experience building, integrating, or evaluating agentic systems, agent harnesses, tool orchestration, or LLM-powered workflows
  • Experience with agentic frameworks and tooling such as LangChain, LangSmith, LangGraph, or similar platforms (PydanticAI, CrewAI, etc)
  • Experience with MCP, vector databases, retrieval patterns, RAG architectures, or AI evaluation platforms
  • Comfortable working across a polyglot stack, especially contributing to or integrating with PHP and Java services when the product requires it
  • Familiarity with prompt and version management, guardrails, tracing, LLM observability, cost and latency optimization, or human-in-the-loop workflows
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and containerization such as Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS, plus experience working with remote-first, globally distributed teams
  • Experience with API-driven design, distributed systems, data modeling, and reliable service boundaries
  • Strong knowledge of software best practices, design patterns, performance, security-minded development, and testing across unit, integration, and end-to-end levels
  • Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills, especially in complex systems with uncertain or probabilistic behavior
  • Good product sense, customer empathy, strong communication, teamwork, ownership, and time management
  • Business-level English fluency, verbal and written

Compensation: Depending on your skills and experience, you can expect your annual compensation to be between $140,000 and $180,000 USD. Please note that we maintain high flexibility, and packages above this range will be considered. (The salary is only for US-based candidates).

Work Authorization: Please note that applicants must be currently authorized to work in the location where the position is located without requiring visa sponsorship. At this time, Cloudbeds is unable to provide sponsorship for work visas.

title: Business Systems Engineer
description: At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀 Job Summary As a Business Systems Engineer on the GTM Engineering team, you will design, build, and operate the automation and AI systems that power ClickUp's Go-To-Market business — spanning core business products and the integration platforms that connect them. This role is AI-native at its core: you won't just maintain existing workflows, you'll actively advance our GTM systems with intelligent agents, LLM-powered automations, and next-generation integration patterns built on MCP, ClickUp Super Agents, and modern iPaaS tooling. You'll sit at the intersection of business systems architecture and applied AI — partnering with Sales, Finance, Revenue Operations, and fellow GTM Systems engineers to eliminate toil, accelerate revenue workflows, and build the automated, AI-augmented infrastructure the company runs on. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone deeply fluent in enterprise business systems, excited about deploying production AI, and committed to genuine ownership of the platforms they build — directly supporting GTMSOE's broader mission of operational excellence across the GTM org. Key Responsibilities AI-Native Automation & Agent Development Design and build AI-powered automations and agentic workflows across the GTM tech stack — including Salesforce, NetSuite, Workato, and MuleSoft — to eliminate manual effort and accelerate business operations. Develop and deploy ClickUp Super Agents and LLM-based automations to automate tasks such as deal data enrichment, quote generation assistance, order validation, revenue recognition triggers, and exception handling in quote-to-cash workflows. Architect and implement MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations that allow AI agents to interact with business systems contextually and safely — enabling intelligent, event-driven actions across the GTM platform. Explore and evaluate emerging AI capabilities (RAG, fine-tuning, multi-agent orchestration) and determine which are production-ready for GTM business systems use cases. Build reusable AI templates, automation patterns, and agent blueprints that can be extended across the GTM Engineering team. Business Systems Integration & Architecture Build and maintain integrations across Salesforce, NetSuite, Workato, MuleSoft, DealHub (CPQ), and other GTM platforms — with a strong bias toward clean architecture, low technical debt, and supportable design. Own end-to-end integration patterns for critical business flows such as lead-to-opportunity, quote-to-cash, order-to-fulfillment, and revenue reporting pipelines. Design data flows and transformation logic that keep business data accurate, consistent, and accessible across systems without creating fragile point-to-point dependencies. Apply a build-vs-buy mindset: evaluate whether a given automation need is best solved with native platform capabilities, iPaaS tooling, or custom code — and make the case clearly. Platform Development & Tooling Build internal tooling, low-code/no-code solutions, and lightweight applications using platforms such as Retool, Replit, or similar to extend business systems capabilities with minimal overhead. Write automation scripts and data transformation logic in Python, JavaScript, or Apex as needed to bridge gaps that platform tooling cannot address natively. Utilize Zapier, Workato, and similar iPaaS platforms to orchestrate cross-system workflows that are maintainable, observable, and well-documented. Own the full lifecycle of what you build: discovery, design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing optimization. Reliability, Observability & Continuous Improvement Monitor the health and performance of automations and integrations you own; proactively identify degradation, data inconsistencies, or failure patterns before they impact business operations. Conduct root-cause analysis of integration failures or automation breakdowns and drive durable fixes — not just incident patches. Maintain runbooks and operational documentation so that platform behavior is understandable and recoverable by the broader team. Gather feedback from business stakeholders and iterate on existing automations to improve accuracy, reduce edge cases, and adapt to evolving GTM processes. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement Partner with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Customer Success stakeholders to translate business requirements into well-scoped technical solutions. Work closely with GTM Systems Engineering, DevOps, and BSA teammates on architecture decisions, intake prioritization, and delivery execution. Contribute to the GTM Systems Engineering operating model: maintain task hygiene, communicate proactively on large initiatives, and log AI/automation work in the team's AI Excellence registry. Serve as a subject matter expert for business systems automation and AI — educating stakeholders on what's possible and setting realistic expectations on scope and delivery. Qualifications Experience 3–5+ years in a business systems engineering, systems administration, or integration engineering role. Demonstrated experience building and shipping automations or integrations that delivered measurable business value in production environments. Hands-on experience with Salesforce and at least one ERP platform (NetSuite strongly preferred). Experience deploying AI or LLM-powered automations in a production business systems context — or a clear, demonstrated trajectory toward it. Experience working in a high-velocity environment where you manage multiple concurrent priorities and adapt quickly to changing business needs. Optional but valued: experience with DealHub (CPQ), ClickUp, quote-to-cash workflows, or revenue operations systems. Skills & Competencies Technical Salesforce configuration, automation (Flow, Process Builder), Apex, and data model design — admin or developer-level proficiency required. NetSuite workflows, SuiteScript, SuiteBundler, saved searches, and data model — particularly as it relates to order management, billing, and revenue recognition. Hands-on experience with Workato, MuleSoft, Zapier, or comparable iPaaS platforms — including multi-step flows, error handling, and observability. Practical experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Claude, etc.), prompt engineering, agentic workflow design, and MCP integrations. Experience with ClickUp Super Agents is a strong plus. Proficient with Python, JavaScript, or Apex for automation scripting and data transformation; comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, and OAuth-based integrations. Strong understanding of business systems data models and integration patterns (event-driven, batch, real-time). Operational & Mindset Ownership: You take full responsibility for the systems you build — from reliability and documentation to stakeholder trust and continuous improvement. raw.jobDescription:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀

Job Summary

As a Business Systems Engineer on the GTM Engineering team, you will design, build, and operate the automation and AI systems that power ClickUp's Go-To-Market business — spanning core business products and the integration platforms that connect them. This role is AI-native at its core: you won't just maintain existing workflows, you'll actively advance our GTM systems with intelligent agents, LLM-powered automations, and next-generation integration patterns built on MCP, ClickUp Super Agents, and modern iPaaS tooling.

You'll sit at the intersection of business systems architecture and applied AI — partnering with Sales, Finance, Revenue Operations, and fellow GTM Systems engineers to eliminate toil, accelerate revenue workflows, and build the automated, AI-augmented infrastructure the company runs on. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone deeply fluent in enterprise business systems, excited about deploying production AI, and committed to genuine ownership of the platforms they build — directly supporting GTMSOE's broader mission of operational excellence across the GTM org.

Key Responsibilities

AI-Native Automation & Agent Development

  • Design and build AI-powered automations and agentic workflows across the GTM tech stack — including Salesforce, NetSuite, Workato, and MuleSoft — to eliminate manual effort and accelerate business operations.

  • Develop and deploy ClickUp Super Agents and LLM-based automations to automate tasks such as deal data enrichment, quote generation assistance, order validation, revenue recognition triggers, and exception handling in quote-to-cash workflows.

  • Architect and implement MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations that allow AI agents to interact with business systems contextually and safely — enabling intelligent, event-driven actions across the GTM platform.

  • Explore and evaluate emerging AI capabilities (RAG, fine-tuning, multi-agent orchestration) and determine which are production-ready for GTM business systems use cases.

  • Build reusable AI templates, automation patterns, and agent blueprints that can be extended across the GTM Engineering team.

Business Systems Integration & Architecture

  • Build and maintain integrations across Salesforce, NetSuite, Workato, MuleSoft, DealHub (CPQ), and other GTM platforms — with a strong bias toward clean architecture, low technical debt, and supportable design.

  • Own end-to-end integration patterns for critical business flows such as lead-to-opportunity, quote-to-cash, order-to-fulfillment, and revenue reporting pipelines.

  • Design data flows and transformation logic that keep business data accurate, consistent, and accessible across systems without creating fragile point-to-point dependencies.

  • Apply a build-vs-buy mindset: evaluate whether a given automation need is best solved with native platform capabilities, iPaaS tooling, or custom code — and make the case clearly.

Platform Development & Tooling

  • Build internal tooling, low-code/no-code solutions, and lightweight applications using platforms such as Retool, Replit, or similar to extend business systems capabilities with minimal overhead.

  • Write automation scripts and data transformation logic in Python, JavaScript, or Apex as needed to bridge gaps that platform tooling cannot address natively.

  • Utilize Zapier, Workato, and similar iPaaS platforms to orchestrate cross-system workflows that are maintainable, observable, and well-documented.

  • Own the full lifecycle of what you build: discovery, design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing optimization.

Reliability, Observability & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor the health and performance of automations and integrations you own; proactively identify degradation, data inconsistencies, or failure patterns before they impact business operations.

  • Conduct root-cause analysis of integration failures or automation breakdowns and drive durable fixes — not just incident patches.

  • Maintain runbooks and operational documentation so that platform behavior is understandable and recoverable by the broader team.

  • Gather feedback from business stakeholders and iterate on existing automations to improve accuracy, reduce edge cases, and adapt to evolving GTM processes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Partner with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Customer Success stakeholders to translate business requirements into well-scoped technical solutions.

  • Work closely with GTM Systems Engineering, DevOps, and BSA teammates on architecture decisions, intake prioritization, and delivery execution.

  • Contribute to the GTM Systems Engineering operating model: maintain task hygiene, communicate proactively on large initiatives, and log AI/automation work in the team's AI Excellence registry.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for business systems automation and AI — educating stakeholders on what's possible and setting realistic expectations on scope and delivery.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 3–5+ years in a business systems engineering, systems administration, or integration engineering role.

  • Demonstrated experience building and shipping automations or integrations that delivered measurable business value in production environments.

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce and at least one ERP platform (NetSuite strongly preferred).

  • Experience deploying AI or LLM-powered automations in a production business systems context — or a clear, demonstrated trajectory toward it.

  • Experience working in a high-velocity environment where you manage multiple concurrent priorities and adapt quickly to changing business needs.

  • Optional but valued: experience with DealHub (CPQ), ClickUp, quote-to-cash workflows, or revenue operations systems.

Skills & Competencies

Technical

  • Salesforce configuration, automation (Flow, Process Builder), Apex, and data model design — admin or developer-level proficiency required.

  • NetSuite workflows, SuiteScript, SuiteBundler, saved searches, and data model — particularly as it relates to order management, billing, and revenue recognition.

  • Hands-on experience with Workato, MuleSoft, Zapier, or comparable iPaaS platforms — including multi-step flows, error handling, and observability.

  • Practical experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Claude, etc.), prompt engineering, agentic workflow design, and MCP integrations. Experience with ClickUp Super Agents is a strong plus.

  • Proficient with Python, JavaScript, or Apex for automation scripting and data transformation; comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, and OAuth-based integrations.

  • Strong understanding of business systems data models and integration patterns (event-driven, batch, real-time).

Operational & Mindset

  • Ownership: You take full responsibility for the systems you build — from reliability and documentation to stakeholder trust and continuous improvement. You don't hand off and walk away.

  • Velocity: You move fast, iterate, and ship. You know when "good enough and deployed" beats "perfect and blocked," and you never sacrifice reliability or data integrity to get there.

  • AI & Automation mindset: You default to asking "how can an agent or LLM handle this?" before reaching for a manual workflow — experimenting confidently and evaluating critically.

  • Collaboration: You bridge the gap between technical architecture and business impact, asking clarifying questions, challenging assumptions respectfully, and earning trust with the stakeholders you support.

  • Growth: You stay current on emerging AI capabilities, evaluate what's production-ready, and continuously raise the bar on what GTM systems can do.

What You'll Work With

  • Salesforce: CRM platform — automations, Flow, Apex, data model, reporting, and CPQ/OTC integrations.

  • NetSuite: ERP platform — SuiteScript, workflows, order management, billing, and revenue recognition flows.

  • ClickUp Super Agents: AI-powered automation and agentic task orchestration within the ClickUp ecosystem.

  • Integration stack: Workato, MuleSoft, Zapier — recipe/flow development, cross-system orchestration, and platform observability.

  • AI & MCP tooling: LLM APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP), agentic workflow design, and production AI integration patterns.

  • Low-code tooling: Retool, Replit, or similar for internal applications and workflow extensions.

  • Scripting & APIs: Python, JavaScript, Apex, REST/webhook integrations, and JSON-based data transformation.

Equal Opportunity Employer

ClickUp is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

Privacy Notice

ClickUp collects and processes personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws. You can find further details by viewing our Global Candidate Privacy Notice.

If you are a Philippine Job Applicant, please also see our Philippine Data Privacy Notice for further details.

Visa Sponsorship

Please note we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for roles outside of engineering and product at this time. Sponsorship for engineering and product roles is not guaranteed, but is instead based on the business needs for that specific role at that time. Please reach out to the recruiter with any questions.

ClickUp Talent Acquisition will only initiate contact via an @clickup.com email or through our official careers portal on clickup.com. We will never request fees, payments, or sensitive personal information. Please disregard any offers received outside these channels and report them to support@clickup.com.

These tools support, but do not replace, human decision‑making. If you have questions or need an accommodation in the recruitment process, please contact us at AskPeople@ClickUp.com.

title: Software Engineer, Data Integration
description: Software Engineer, Data Integration In Brief We're a rapidly growing startup on a mission to make healthcare proactive by empowering physicians, nurses, and care team members with real-time data to save lives. Join us in transforming healthcare from reactive to proactive. You’ll spearhead the engineering effort to build the bridge between massive, complex Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and the Bayesian platform, delivering critical, real-time insights to help clinicians save lives. Who We Are Bayesian Health’s mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point-of-care. We’re a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, machine learning experts, product designers, and performance improvement leaders committed to enabling smarter, patient-specific care delivery through unlocking the power of data. We’re funded by top tier tech and biotech investors: Obvious Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, American Medical Association’s venture arm, Catalio Partners, and LifeForce Capital. Our company has won many awards; most recent recognitions include: Forbes AI Top 50, World Economic Forum Tech Pioneer, Time Best Inventions, BioTech AI Company of the Year. Read more about our recent publication in Nature Medicine that associates our products with lives saved. What you’ll do You will be at the forefront of a high-impact engineering mission, building the bridge between massive, complex Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and the Bayesian platform to generate real-time lifesaving clinical insights that clinicians rely on. Working directly with our health system clients' technical teams, you'll turn fragmented data into immediate, actionable clinical insights that empower care teams to make the best decisions for their patients. Each integration is a partnership. An Implementation Lead owns the client relationship and project management; a Clinical Integration owns clinical workflow design and training. You own the technical workstream — which means you're the engineer in the room. When a lab result isn't reaching the Bayesian platform for a patient, you have thirty minutes and the client's full attention to trace it from the inbound HL7 message through parsing, mapping, and ingestion, and tell them what happened. Responsibilities Data Integration & Ingestion: Partner with the client's technical teams to design and implement the data integration interface and ingestion pipelines that feed the Bayesian platform with real-time clinical data, powering insights that improve patient outcomes. Integration Testing & Troubleshooting: Implement automated integration tests at the data layer, and work directly with client technical teams during integration testing to investigate and resolve issues, ensuring smooth and timely integrations. Production Deployment & Go-Live: Execute the deployment process in close collaboration with the client's technical team, ensuring build and configuration for the data interface, ingestion, and mapping are successfully promoted to production for a seamless launch. During go-live week, you will serve as the technical point of contact for any data integration issues, both internally and with the client's teams, providing clear status updates to cross-functional partners so they can effectively manage client communication. Integration Tooling & Automation: Develop frameworks and tooling, leveraging LLMs and automation, to increase the efficiency and velocity of our platform integrations as we scale. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work alongside an Implementation Lead, Clinical Integration, and the client's technical teams to align the data integration workstream with the overall integration effort. Minimum qualifications BS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience 3+ years building and deploying data pipelines to production, including integration with external APIs (Python preferred) Strong ability to investigate and resolve data correctness problem end-to-end, across services, storage, and external data sources. Experience with cloud solutions (AWS, Azure, etc.) and relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.) in a production environment Experience writing automated integration tests for production systems Strong communicator with a demonstrated ability to collaborate across functions, working effectively with internal stakeholders, including Project/Product Managers, to align on priorities and deliver results. Preferred qualifications Experience with health data, integration with Electronic Health Records (EHR) systems, and Health IT interoperability standards such as HL7v2 and FHIR. Experience rolling out production deployments, supporting systems through go-live via an on-call or support rotation, and triaging production issues Experience working with enterprise customers, and the agility and responsiveness they require. Experience building internal tooling or automation, including leveraging LLMs, to improve engineering velocity Bayesian Health provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Operations Tools & Al Enablement
description: At Serve Robotics , we’re reimagining how things move in cities. Our personable sidewalk robot is our vision for the future. It’s designed to take deliveries away from congested streets, make deliveries available to more people, and benefit local businesses. The Serve fleet has been delighting merchants, customers, and pedestrians along the way in Los Angeles, Miami, Dallas, Atlanta and Chicago while doing commercial deliveries. We’re looking for talented individuals who will grow robotic deliveries from surprising novelty to efficient ubiquity. Who We Are We are tech industry veterans in software, hardware, and design who are pooling our skills to build the future we want to live in. We are solving real-world problems leveraging robotics, machine learning and computer vision, among other disciplines, with a mindful eye towards the end-to-end user experience. Our team is agile, diverse, and driven. We believe that the best way to solve complicated dynamic problems is collaboratively and respectfully. JOB OVERVIEW Build practical software that makes Robotics Operations more effective. We are looking for a proactive engineer with a product and entrepreneurial mindset: someone who discovers opportunities, anticipates pain points, and turns them into useful, reliable software. You will deliver improvements quickly and own the tools we rely on, including applications originally built with Al-assisted coding. You will be an engineer embedded with Operations, taking initiative to understand how teams work and where software can make the biggest difference. You will observe workflows, ask questions, and use feedback and data to uncover unmet needs, including problems users have learned to work around. You will help shape what gets built, rather than wait for a fully defined task list. Think like a product owner and execute as an engineer. Connect everyday friction to the bigger picture: delivery quality, operator effectiveness, and the ability to scale. Choose focused improvements that create meaningful value, test assumptions early, and adapt as you learn. We value initiative, product judgment, and demonstrated impact over the length of an engineering résumé alone. Some solutions will start as lightweight prototypes or Al-generated applications. Your job is to bring the engineering judgment needed to make them dependable: understand the code, fix defects, improve the design where needed, add appropriate tests and monitoring, and support the application as operational needs and underlying systems change. You will personally build, ship, and maintain production code. Al-assisted development is encouraged, but you must be able to evaluate the output, debug it independently, and take responsibility for its behavior in production. You will work across several programming languages. Our primary system is Elixir-heavy. Previous Elixir experience is not required, but you should be ready to learn quickly and become productive developing and maintaining Elixir applications. You will also work with applications and services on Google Cloud Platform (GP). You will work cross-functionally with Operations, Product Engineering, and other technical teams to make sure local improvements work with the wider system. Build shared understanding, surface dependencies early, and drive decisions through completion. You will know when a small Operations tool is the right answer, when an existing solution can be reused, and when a problem requires a coordinated change to shared services or core product functionality. JOB DUTIES Discover needs before they become urgent. Proactively explore workflows with Operations, identify recurring friction and emerging failure points, and propose improvements before teams need to escalate a problem. Prioritize and deliver quick wins. Connect opportunities to operational goals, assess user impact, effort, and risk, and choose the smallest useful solution. Make clear recommendations about what to build, improve, reuse, or leave alone. Build iteratively with users. Deliver small, useful changes, gather feedback early, and refine solutions based on how people use them. Keep the scope focused while ensuring the result is safe and fit for its intended use. Own Operations applications. Maintain and improve internal tools, dashboards, automations, and integrations, including applications initially created through Al-assisted coding. Diagnose issues, resolve bugs, and keep tools working as dependencies and requirements evolve. Develop across our stack. Contribute in several languages, ramp up quickly on our Elixir-heavy core system, and build, deploy, troubleshoot, and support applications on Google Cloud Platform. &X. Metaview Bring engineering discipline to Al-built software. Review generated code, understand its dependencies and data access, address security and reliability gaps, and add tests, documentation, monitoring, and maintainable structure appropriate to the application's risk. Drive cross-functional execution. Align Operations and Engineering on needs, owners, dependencies, and tradeoffs. Anticipate the effects of API, schema, authentication, and platform changes on Operations tools. Bring recommendations to the teams that own shared systems, resolve blockers, and follow through on commitments rather than building fragile workarounds. Champion practical Al adoption. Help Operations identify useful Al-assisted workflows, evaluate tools, and develop safe, repeatable practices. Help colleagues understand where Al saves time and where human review and engineering ownership are essential. Stay accountable after launch. Support the software you ship, investigate failures, and verify that improvements reduce operational friction or improve delivery quality. Favor durable fixes over recurring manual intervention. EXPERIENCE, QUALIFICATIONS, & SKILLS Required Experience, Qualifications, and Skills 5+ years of professional experience, with substantial software engineering experience and ownership of shipped software. We prioritize what you have identified, built, and improved over tenure alone. Strong production coding capability. You can independently design, implement, test, debug, deploy, and maintain applications. You can understand and improve an unfamiliar codebase, including code generated with Al assistance. Google Cloud Platform experience. You have built, deployed, or supported applications and services on GCP and can troubleshoot their behavior in a cloud environment. Ability to learn and contribute across languages. You can become productive quickly in an unfamiliar stack. Prior Elixir experience is not required; learning it quickly and contributing to our Elixir-heavy system is an expectation of the role. Experience building useful applications, internal tools, automations, or integrations for business or operational users. A proactive, self-starting approach. You can find a worthwhile problem, investigate it independently, propose a path forward, and take ownership without waiting for detailed instructions. Product and entrepreneurial judgment. You understand user needs, challenge assumptions, balance speed with quality, and focus effort on solutions people will use. You can create clarity and momentum when the problem or solution is not yet well defined. Big-picture thinking. You connect a local workflow improvement to broader operational goals, recognize upstream and downstream effects, and avoid optimizing one tool at the expense of the wider system. Sound judgment about testing, code review, access controls, sensitive data, dependency management, observability, and production support. A practical, iterative approach: you can deliver a small improvement quickly without losing sight of reliability, maintainability, or user needs. Ability to work directly with non-engineering users, clarify ambiguous requests, explain tradeoffs, and turn feedback into working improvements. Cross-functional leadership through influence: you can bring operational and engineering perspectives together, explain tradeoffs, secure alignment, and keep work moving through release and adoption. Interest in Al-assisted development and workflow automation, paired with the ability to validate results and recognize limitations. Previous experience managing an operations team is not required. This role is centered on building and supporting software for Operations, rather than managing a program or coordinating other engineers' delivery. Preferred Experience, Qualifications, and Skills Experience with operator-facing applications, workflow automation, dashboards, or fleet and robotics tools. Full-stack development experience, including user interfaces, services, APls, and data integrations. Previous experience developing applications in Elixir. Experience taking a prototype or lightly engineered application into dependable operational use. Effective use of Al coding assistants, with examples of reviewing, correcting, testing, and maintaining their output. Experience owning a product or internal tool from discovery through adoption and iteration, or building useful solutions in an entrepreneurial environment. Experience helping non-technical teams adopt Al tools responsibly. Robotics, autonomous vehicles, logistics, delivery, or other technology-enabled field operations experience. What success looks like Operations receives useful improvements in short iterations, with feedback shaping subsequent work. Important needs and risks are surfaced early, with solutions initiated before they become urgent requests or recurring incidents. Tools are adopted and deliver measurable value, with low-value ideas changed or stopped based on evidence. Cross-functional partners have clear ownership and fewer surprises as tools and underlying systems evolve. High-value internal applications have clear technical ownership and dependable support. Al-built tools become easier to understand, test, change, and maintain. Changes to shared engineering systems cause fewer avoidable disruptions to Operations tools. Teams spend less time on repetitive work and recurring software issues. Al adoption produces practical benefits without compromising data handling, reliability, or engineering standards.

  • Discover needs before they become urgent. Proactively explore workflows with Operations, identify recurring friction and emerging failure points, and propose improvements before teams need to escalate a problem.

  • Prioritize and deliver quick wins. Connect opportunities to operational goals, assess user impact, effort, and risk, and choose the smallest useful solution. Make clear recommendations about what to build, improve, reuse, or leave alone.

  • Build iteratively with users. Deliver small, useful changes, gather feedback early, and refine solutions based on how people use them. Keep the scope focused while ensuring the result is safe and fit for its intended use.

  • Own Operations applications. Maintain and improve internal tools, dashboards, automations, and integrations, including applications initially created through Al-assisted coding. Diagnose issues, resolve bugs, and keep tools working as dependencies and requirements evolve.

  • Develop across our stack. Contribute in several languages, ramp up quickly on our Elixir-heavy core system, and build, deploy, troubleshoot, and support applications on Google Cloud Platform. &X. Metaview

  • Bring engineering discipline to Al-built software. Review generated code, understand its dependencies and data access, address security and reliability gaps, and add tests, documentation, monitoring, and maintainable structure appropriate to the application's risk.

  • Drive cross-functional execution. Align Operations and Engineering on needs, owners, dependencies, and tradeoffs. Anticipate the effects of API, schema, authentication, and platform changes on Operations tools. Bring recommendations to the teams that own shared systems, resolve blockers, and follow through on commitments rather than building fragile workarounds.

  • Champion practical Al adoption. Help Operations identify useful Al-assisted workflows, evaluate tools, and develop safe, repeatable practices. Help colleagues understand where Al saves time and where human review and engineering ownership are essential.

  • Stay accountable after launch. Support the software you ship, investigate failures, and verify that improvements reduce operational friction or improve delivery quality. Favor durable fixes over recurring manual intervention.
